results.evidence: On August 17, 2026, UHS completed its acquisition of Talkspace, Inc., with each share of Talkspace common stock converting into the right to receive $5.25 in cash. The acquisition was financed with $400 million from a delayed draw term loan and additional borrowings under the revolving credit facility.
results.verifiedQuote: At the effective time of the Merger, each share of Talkspace common stock, par value $0.0001 per share ("Talkspace Common Stock") (other than shares of Talkspace Common Stock canceled pursuant to the Merger Agreement), automatically converted into the right to receive $5.25 in cash, without interest.

During the six months ended June 30, 2026, UHS repurchased $488.4 million of common shares (including excise tax). Dividends of $24.5 million were paid and accrued during the same period, indicating an ongoing dividend program.

Cash and cash equivalents were $138.8 million at June 30, 2026, compared to $137.8 million at December 31, 2025. This represents a modest increase and is not a large cash balance relative to the company's $15.9 billion in total assets.

The Tranche A Term Loan ($1.448 billion outstanding as of June 30, 2026) and the Revolving Credit Facility ($225 million drawn) bear interest at floating rates based on SOFR or ABR plus applicable margins. These floating-rate borrowings represent approximately 45% of total debt outstanding.
results.verifiedQuote: Revolving credit and existing term loan A borrowings under the Credit Agreement, after giving effect to the Eleventh Amendment, bear interest at our election at either (1) the ABR rate which is defined as the rate per annum equal to the greatest of (a) the lender's prime rate, (b) the greater of the federal funds effective rate and the overnight bank funding rate, plus 0.5 % and (c) one month term SOFR rate plus 1.0 %, in each case, plus an applicable margin based upon our consolidated leverage ratio at the end of each quarter ranging from 0.25 % to 0.625 %, or (2) the one, three or six month term SOFR rate (at our election), plus an applicable margin based upon our consolidated leverage ratio at the end of each quarter ranging from 1.25 % to 1.625 %.

UHS uses forward exchange contracts to hedge its net investment in foreign operations (primarily UK behavioral health facilities). During the six months ended June 30, 2026, net cash inflows from these contracts were $12 million. The company recorded net investment hedge gains of $13.1 million in AOCI for the six-month period.
results.verifiedQuote: We use forward exchange contracts to hedge our net investment in foreign operations against movements in exchange rates. The effective portion of the unrealized gains or losses on these contracts is recorded in foreign currency translation adjustment within accumulated other comprehensive income and remains there until either the sale or liquidation of the subsidiary.
